priority_items.title: Vavaʻu whale-watching boat mishap; no fatality reported; licensing unconfirmed
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ Pacific pubDate 19:31:47Z is now RSS #1, wiring Kaniva Tonga: a passenger-carrying whale-watching boat was involved in an accident in Vavaʻu. Neiafu Town Officer Vava Lapota reports no loss of life. Passenger count, cause, police response, and licensing status remain unconfirmed. Distinct from the 21 Aug Tongatapu Anglican capsize (later unlicensed) and the earlier-September Siokapesi Hefa fatality. No Tonga Tourism/Marine statement located. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Vuvale committee asks whether climate finance is accessible; TSLS grant phase-out is domestic
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC 18 Sep 7:03 am FJT / 19:03 UTC: Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs and Defence, Vuvale Union / Ocean of Peace. Aliki Bia asks whether the treaty turns climate commitments into practical, accessible funding. No new dollar figure, not a signed instrument. Distinct FBC 7:00 am FJT / 19:00 UTC: TSLS Graduate Business Start-Up Grant being phased out pending review — domestic, not PALM. fiji.gov.fj and laws.gov.fj still silent on CRC report and HIV gazette. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.
